```{r}
source("./pipe.R")
input = pipeline$bulk_mar25_HCC$input
output = pipeline$bulk_mar25_HCC$output
```


```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(GSEABase))
source_from_github(repositoy = "DEG_functions",version = "0.2.54")
```
#signatures

```{r}
genesets = getGmt(input$genesets) %>% geneIds()
# add senesence signatures to genesets
SASP_signature = c("CCL2", "CCL5", "CCL7", "IL1A", "IL1B", "IL32","SCG2", "INHBA", "INHA", "WNT7A", "CSF2", "TNFRSF11B", "GREM1", "CMTM3")
FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP  = getGmt(input$SENESCENCE) %>% geneIds() %>%  unlist() %>% base::unname()

genesets = c(genesets, list(SASP = SASP_signature,
                        FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP = FRIDMAN_SENESCENCE_UP))

hif_targets =  scan(input$hif_targets, character(), quote = "")
genesets[["HIF_targets"]] = hif_targets

```

# Create data
```{r}
bulk_Mar25_raw = read.table(
  file = input$rna_counts,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE
) %>% as.data.frame() 

bulk_Mar25_TPM = bulk_Mar25_raw %>%   dplyr::select(!c("Geneid","Chr", "Start", "End", "Strand","Length"))
rownames(bulk_Mar25_TPM) = make.unique(bulk_Mar25_TPM[,"gene_name",drop=T])
bulk_Mar25_TPM  = bulk_Mar25_TPM %>% dplyr::select(!c("gene_name"))
colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM) = gsub(pattern = ".bam",replacement = "",x = colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM))


```

```{r}
#adjust sample names
#read xlsx file
library(readxl)
sample_description = readxl::read_xlsx(input$sample_description, sheet = 1) %>% 
  as.data.frame() 

sample_description = sample_description %>%  mutate(new_name = paste(sample_description$`Group Name\r\n(Required)`,c(1:3),sep = "_")) 


bulk_Mar25_TPM = bulk_Mar25_TPM[,sample_description$`Sample Name`]
colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM) = sample_description$new_name
colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM)  = colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM) %>%  
  gsub(pattern = "_Osi_",replacement = "_osi_short_") %>% 
  gsub(pattern = "_OsiRox_",replacement = "_osi_short_roxa_") %>% 
  gsub(pattern = "_Per_",replacement = "_osi_persistor_") %>% 
  gsub(pattern = "_PerRox_",replacement = "_osi_persist_roxa_") 


```


```{r}
# get cell line
cell_line_bulk = bulk_Mar25_TPM[,startsWith(colnames(bulk_Mar25_TPM),params$cell_line)]
```



```{r}
# create metadata
cell.labels = names(cell_line_bulk)
condition = str_extract(cell.labels, "Veh|osi_short_[1-9]|Rox|osi_short_roxa|osi_persistor|osi_persist_roxa") %>% gsub(pattern = "_[1-9]",replacement = "")
peristor = str_extract(cell.labels, "short|persist")
metadata = data.frame(condition = condition, row.names = colnames(cell_line_bulk))
```

```{r}
metadata_orig = metadata
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    state = case_when(
      grepl("persist", condition) ~ "osi_persistent",
      grepl("short", condition) ~ "osi_short",
      TRUE ~ "Vec"
    ),
    roxa = ifelse(grepl("roxa", condition) | condition == "Rox", "yes", "no")
  )


#filter out osi short
keep <- metadata$condition %in% c("Veh", "Rox", "osi_persistor", "osi_persist_roxa")
cell_line_bulk_orig = cell_line_bulk
cell_line_bulk   <- cell_line_bulk[, keep]
metadata     <- metadata[keep, , drop=FALSE]



metadata$state = factor(metadata$state, levels = c("Vec","osi_persistent"))
metadata$roxa = factor(metadata$roxa, levels = c("no", "yes"))

metadata
```


```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(cell_line_bulk),
                              colData = metadata,
                              design = ~ state + roxa + state:roxa)
```
```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds)  
```

```{r}
resultsNames(dds)
```
```{r}
res_interaction <- results(dds, contrast = list(
  c("stateosi_persistent.roxayes")
))
```

```{r}
res_interaction <- res_interaction[!is.na(res_interaction$padj), ]
res_interaction = res_interaction[order(res_interaction$log2FoldChange,decreasing = T), ] %>% as.data.frame()
```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=13, results='asis'}
ranked_vec = res_interaction[,"log2FoldChange"]%>% setNames(rownames(res_interaction)) %>% na.omit() %>%  #order by FC
  sort(decreasing = T) # sort

# create 6 breaks between plot limits in log scale and then exponent, otherwise breaks not good
breaks_fun = function(limits){ 
  breaks = exp(-seq(-log(limits[1]), -log(limits[2]), length.out = 6))
  breaks[1] = breaks[1] * 0.95 #adjust extreme ticks to prevent truncation
  breaks[7] = breaks[7] * 1.05
  return(signif(breaks, digits = 2))
}

hyp_obj <- hypeR_fgsea(ranked_vec, genesets, up_only = F)
plt = hyp_dots(hyp_obj,merge = F)
plt1 = plt$up+ aes(size=nes)+ggtitle("higher rox effect in DTP than parental")+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = hypeR:::.reverselog_trans(10), 
        breaks =breaks_fun)
plt2 = plt$dn+ aes(size=abs(nes))+ggtitle("higher rox effect in parental than DTP")+
  scale_y_continuous(trans = hypeR:::.reverselog_trans(10), 
        breaks =breaks_fun)
plt1+plt2
```
```{r}
#from https://www.r-bloggers.com/2024/05/a-guide-to-designs-and-contrasts-in-deseq2/
roxa_within_ctrl = results(dds, contrast=c("roxa", "yes", "no"))
roxa_within_persisters = results(dds, contrast=list(c("roxa_yes_vs_no", "stateosi_persistent.roxayes")))

```

```{r}
up_driving_genes = hyp_obj[["data"]][["up"]][["data"]] %>% filter(fdr<0.05) %>% pull(le) %>% strsplit(split = ",")
names(up_driving_genes) = hyp_obj[["data"]][["up"]][["data"]] %>% filter(fdr<0.05) %>% pull(label)
head(up_driving_genes)
```

```{r}
fc_parental_vec = c()
fc_dtp_vec = c()

for (geneset_name in names(up_driving_genes)) {
  genes = up_driving_genes[[geneset_name]]
  scores = cell_line_bulk[genes,] %>% colMeans() %>% data.frame(row.names = names(.), score =.)
  scores = merge(x = scores,y = metadata,by = 0) %>% column_to_rownames("Row.names")
  scores$condition = factor(scores$condition,levels = c("Veh","Rox","osi_short","osi_short_roxa","osi_persistor","osi_persist_roxa"))
  fc_parental = mean(scores %>% filter(condition == "Rox") %>% pull(score)) /mean(scores %>% filter(condition == "Veh") %>% pull(score))
  fc_dtp = mean(scores %>% filter(condition == "osi_persist_roxa") %>% pull(score)) /mean(scores %>% filter(condition == "osi_persistor") %>%
                                                                                            pull(score))
  fc_parental_vec = c(fc_parental_vec,fc_parental)
  fc_dtp_vec = c(fc_dtp_vec,fc_dtp)

}
all_fc = data.frame(pathway = names(up_driving_genes),fc_dtp = fc_dtp_vec, fc_parental = fc_parental_vec )
all_fc
```

```{r}

# Reshape the data from wide to long format
fc_long <- all_fc %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(fc_dtp, fc_parental),
    names_to = "group",
    values_to = "fold_change"
  )
fc_long$pathway <- factor(fc_long$pathway, levels = names(up_driving_genes))

# Create the grouped bar plot with a dashed reference line
ggplot(fc_long, aes(x = pathway, y = fold_change, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  # Add the dashed horizontal line at y = 1
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Up in dtp FC",
    x = "Pathway",
    y = "Fold Change",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 2), "cm")  

  )
```
